sources.title: Guidelines for Completing a Visa Application
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Botswana, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official Embassy site publishes the consular guidelines, exact visa-free and visa-required country schedules, and links directly to Botswana's eVisa service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Here is the full list of countries whose citizens do not require a visa to enter Botswana:

sources.title: Visa Application – Tourism Visa
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship, Government of Botswana
sources.officialityEvidence: The current government service page identifies the Department of Immigration and Citizenship as responsible and directs eligible visa-required tourists to the official eVisa portal or a mission/immigration office.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All non-citizens from countries that require visa to enter Botswana as tourists are eligible.

sources.title: About Our Country: Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: Current national government travel-information page provides visitor passport-validity, maximum-stay, border-visa and extension information.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitors are not allowed to stay in Botswana for more than 90 days in every calendar year.

sources.title: Countries Requiring Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Botswana Tourism Organisation is a statutory Ministry of Environment and Tourism parastatal, as the Government of Botswana ministry page identifies; its current traveller page calls its table the list of all countries requiring visas.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Below is a list of all the countries that require visas.

sources.title: Botswana e-Visa
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship, Government of Botswana
sources.officialityEvidence: The central Government tourism-visa service page directly links this gov.bw electronic service for online visa applications. Its live bare-domain frontend loads, but its visible shell is dated 2021 and the selector did not yield nationality evidence in this review.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Continue the online Visa Application process.

sources.title: Botswana and Rwanda Sign Six Bilateral Agreements
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government of Botswana's current news page reports the bilateral visa-abolition agreement, its immediate effect, and Botswana's implementation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The visa abolition agreement takes immediate effect, with Rwanda already implementing it and Botswana following suit.

sources.title: Mozambique
sources.publisher: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
sources.officialityEvidence: The Australian Government foreign-affairs country brief expressly identifies Mozambique as a Commonwealth member, supplying the membership fact needed to apply Botswana's own current Commonwealth rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Mozambique is a member of the Commonwealth, the Southern African Development Community and the Indian Ocean Rim Association.

sources.title: Information on visa and visa-free regimes by passport type
sources.publisher: Consular Department, Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
sources.officialityEvidence: The Russian Foreign Ministry Consular Department's current official visa-regime table lists Botswana as visa-free for Russian citizens for up to 90 days and separately links the 2019 agreement covering citizens of both countries.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free short visitors
policies.summary: The official Washington Embassy's full current named visa-free schedule supports this reconcilable ordinary-passport cohort. Passports disputed by the current statutory Tourism Organisation schedule are excluded.
conditions: The Embassy lists this cohort among countries whose citizens do not require a visa. It does not establish visa-free work, residence, business, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document or individual-admissibility treatment.

Government guidance requires a passport valid at least six months in the absence of a specific bilateral agreement, caps visitor stays at 90 days in each calendar year, and says extensions are available from Immigration.
No general arrival authorization or visa-on-arrival status is inferred. Border officials may apply normal documentary, health, security and admission controls.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: advance online tourist visa
policies.summary: The official Washington Embassy required-country schedule, supplemented for Marshall Islands by the statutory Tourism Organisation's required list, establishes a visitor visa requirement. The Department of Immigration makes the tourist application available online through the official eVisa portal and at missions; it is normalized as an advance eVisa route.
conditions: Submit the tourism-visa application before travel through the official eVisa portal, or at an Immigration office, Botswana mission or consulate. The Department says online approval/rejection is accessed in the portal.

An online-approved traveller may travel with the approval letter as proof of the visa; Immigration prints the visa at the airport or other port of entry. This post-approval printing is not a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival finding.

The Government page says the service takes 7–14 working days. A tourism visa is for recreational travel, with a single entry up to one month or multiple entry up to three months; it does not authorize work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document treatment.

The application requires a passport valid at least six months, photographs, covering letter, flight and accommodation itinerary, trip itinerary and intention to depart; a re-entry permit may be required for the country of residence. Approval and admission remain discretionary.

Government visitor information caps visitors at 90 days in each calendar year and permits extensions through Immigration. The cited nationality schedules lack effective dates and include obsolete or inconsistent country labels; the eVisa frontend is dated 2021 and did not yield selector evidence. Reconfirm directly with Immigration before travel or promotion.

application.label: Botswana Government eVisa service
application.processingTime: Government tourism-visa guidance states 7–14 working days after application.
steps: Apply online through the official Botswana eVisa service before travel, or submit Form 1 at Immigration or a Botswana mission or consulate.
Upload the stated passport, photographs, purpose, itinerary, accommodation and onward-departure evidence; supply any required residence-country re-entry documentation.
Wait for approval before travel, carry the approval letter and supporting documents, and complete Immigration examination and visa printing at the port of entry.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: visa-free under the current bilateral abolition agreement
policies.summary: Botswana's Government states that the Rwanda visa-abolition agreement took immediate effect on 6 May 2026 and that Botswana was implementing it. This current destination-government rule supersedes the older eVisa classification.
conditions: The source establishes visa abolition for Rwandan citizens; it does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Mozambican ordinary passports: current Commonwealth exemption
policies.summary: Botswana's current Government guidance exempts citizens of Commonwealth countries other than seven named exceptions. Mozambique is a current Commonwealth member and is not one of those exceptions.
conditions: The exemption is derived from Botswana's express current Commonwealth rule, together with official confirmation that Mozambique is a Commonwealth member; the seven named visa-required Commonwealth countries do not include Mozambique.
The sources do not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passports: current visa-free entry under the bilateral agreement
policies.summary: The Russian Foreign Ministry's current consular table states that Russian citizens enter Botswana visa-free for up to 90 days and links the 2019 bilateral agreement on mutual abolition of visa requirements for citizens. Botswana's current Government guidance confirms that nationals covered by a visa-abolition agreement do not require a visa.
conditions: The Russian Foreign Ministry table states visa-free entry for Russian citizens for up to 90 days. It separately distinguishes the older diplomatic-and-service-passport agreement from the 2019 agreement covering citizens.
The sources do not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Botswana's current visitor guidance states a maximum stay of 90 days in each calendar year; ordinary passport validity and other border conditions remain applicable.
